headline: Dutch-Made Missiles Helped Collapse the Kerch Bridge and Russia Is Asking Who Is Really at War
summary: Destinus's president told Dutch media that Ukraine fired nine Ruta Block 1 cruise missiles at the Kerch Bridge, seven of which hit the target. Destinus says these were the only foreign-made weapons used.
why: Defense exporters such as Destinus are exposed to shifts in European arms policy and demand driven by the war in Ukraine.
